ZaZet Gal Tidhar

Facebook · croatianferries.com

One post per group, in its language, with its port.

81 groups from today's sweep, biggest first. Each card has the post in the group's language with the matching port page linked, a Copy button, and a hero in the site's own look showing that port's real departures for today (from the spine, same data as the site). Click Posted as you go; it saves. Rules of thumb: post from your personal profile, not a page; one group every 20-30 minutes, not all at once, or Facebook flags it as spam; in private groups read the rules first, several ban links and want you to answer questions instead - there, comment the link under a "when is the ferry" question rather than posting.

The four texts

Same story in each language. The line "For this group: PORT: link" is swapped per card; for general travel groups it is dropped and the hero is Split.

01 · Beautiful Croatia

https://www.facebook.com/groups/692619298622572/ · 410K · Public · language en · hero port general (Split)

Biggest general group. Post the Split hero; the four-language line matters here.

I got tired of decoding the Jadrolinija PDF to find out when the next ferry leaves, so I built a small site that just answers it.

croatianferries.com

Open a port and you get the next departure and "in 23 min" above it, the crossing time, whether the line takes a reservation, and the live HAK camera of the port so you can see the actual queue, not only the timetable. Every car-ferry line in Croatia, 52 ports, in English, Croatian, German and Italian. No app, no cookies, no ads. Open, read, close.

It is brand new and I read all 23 timetables myself, so if you spot a wrong time please tell me and I will fix it the same day. I keep them updated whenever Jadrolinija changes a PDF.

croatianferries.com

Hafen öffnen, und man sieht die nächste Abfahrt mit "in 23 Min." darüber, die Überfahrtsdauer, ob die Linie reservierbar ist, und die Live-Kamera des Hafens vom kroatischen Autoklub HAK, damit man die echte Warteschlange sieht und nicht nur den Fahrplan.
